scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/manifest.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/math.test.mjs tests/explain.test.mjs tests/names.test.mjs tests/priceUpdate.test.mjs tests/governance.test.mjs tests/swarm.test.mjs tests/theme.test.mjs tests/history.test.mjs tests/infer.test.mjs tests/blog.test.mjs tests/infer-worker.test.mjs tests/rpc-cache.test.mjs tests/rpc-archive.test.mjs tests/moon.test.mjs tests/swap.unit.test.mjs tests/swap.fork.test.mjs tests/leverage.unit.test.mjs tests/loop.fork.test.mjs tests/lp.unit.test.mjs tests/lp.fork.test.mjs tests/season.test.mjs tests/swap0x.unit.test.mjs tests/swap0x.worker.test.mjs tests/history-api.test.mjs tests/history-index.test.mjs tests/resilience.test.mjs
scripts.build:public: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode public && node scripts/public-check.mjs
scripts.deploy:public: npm run build:public && npx -y wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.build:launch: npm run typecheck && VITE_TERMINAL=1 vite build --mode public && node scripts/manifest.mjs --out dist-public && node scripts/public-check.mjs --launch
scripts.deploy:launch: npm run build:launch && npx -y wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.build:infer: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode infer && node scripts/infer-check.mjs
scripts.deploy:infer: npm run build:infer && npx -y wrangler@4 deploy -c wrangler.infer.jsonc
scripts.build:blog: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode blog && node scripts/blog-check.mjs
scripts.deploy:blog: npm run build:blog && npx -y wrangler@4 deploy -c wrangler.blog.jsonc
scripts.deploy:whitepaper: node whitepaper/stage.mjs && npx -y wrangler@4 deploy -c wrangler.whitepaper.jsonc
